description: Chintu hathi aur Mithu tota sikhayenge ki kaise mazedaar tarike se haath dhote hain. Yeh pyara gaana bachhon ko swachhta ki aadat daalne mein madad karega.
learning: Teaches proper handwashing steps and the importance of hygiene for toddlers.

scenes.text:
चलो करें जादू, हाथ धोएं सब मिलके
पानी और साबुन, नाचे झूम-झूम के
scenes.image_prompt: A cute round orange elephant with a blue scarf and a tiny green parrot with a red cap standing by a colorful sink, splashing water playfully.

scenes.text:
Scrub the fingers, one by one
Making bubbles is so much fun

scenes.text:
